title: Vancouver
subtitle: Rainy city streets, ferries and forest walks on Bowen Island, snow at Whistler and a climb above Deep Cove.
location: Vancouver · Bowen Island · Whistler · Deep Cove, British Columbia

cover.alt: A seaplane taxiing across Vancouver Harbour below cargo ships, the North Shore waterfront and cloud-wrapped mountains.
cover.caption: A seaplane taxiing across Vancouver Harbour below cargo ships, the North Shore waterfront and cloud-wrapped mountains.

paragraphs: Low clouds hang over the harbour. After dark, wet streets reflect the lamps and shop windows around Gastown.
Friends gather by the harbour before the walk continues past shop windows and reflections on the wet streets.

chapters.title: A lake among the trees
paragraphs: The trail follows the water through dense evergreens. Fallen timber, a wooden bridge and bare trunks interrupt the reflections.
Streams, a small hatchery and a forest shop sit along the woodland walk. Boardwalks cross wet ground before the path reaches the lake.

chapters.title: On the way to the snow
paragraphs: Snow covers the riverbanks between the evergreen trees on the way towards Whistler.

chapters.title: Snow and cloud at Whistler
paragraphs: Skiers move between the lifts and lodge in low cloud. Clearer openings reveal forested valleys, snowy ridges and gondolas above the slopes.
Passengers gather beneath the beams and cables inside the mountain gondola station.
